scenario: A parametric insurance adjuster processes a tropical storm claim where payout depends on whether the nearest certified weather station recorded a peak sustained-wind reading at or above the policy trigger threshold (64 kt / 74 mph) during the storm observation window. The pipeline ingests raw station observation CSV data, normalizes wind speed units to a common scale, computes the quality-weighted peak reading from eligible stations, and submits the result to the insurance claims processor to determine trigger status and authorize or deny payout.
info_flow: csv-pipeline reads station_observations.csv, applies quality-flag filtering and computes weighted-average peak wind speed → unit-convert normalizes the peak reading to knots (kt) for policy comparison → afrexai-insurance-claims evaluates whether the normalized peak meets the 64 kt trigger and recommends payout or denial.
